laws.summary: AI Input Gateway owns provider delivery, response retrieval, transport proof, and provider adapters, but must not own business judgment.
AI capability group owns cognitive tasks and output schemas; AI Input Gateway owns external AI transport and provider adapters.
Each AI provider channel must be isolated as an adapter behind the AI Input Gateway contract.
Web chat AI adapters must use only operator-authorized browser sessions and must not bypass login, captcha, account limits, or read secrets.
Web chat adapters must not cause active mission tab drift and must preserve or restore the source browsing context.
AI feed input must be a governed prompt package with explicit refs, size limits, and no sensitive browser data.
Every AI feed must produce raw output proof, normalized text, parse status, and schema validation result.
AI feed gateway must expose provider cost and rate guard controls and must not submit unbounded requests.
Phase 1 is limited to Gemini API, Gemini Web Chat, and GPT Web Chat feeding only.
Business plugins must not call AI provider SDKs or web chat adapters directly; they must call AI task capabilities.
CI-FULL is the only complete quality gate and connects current law files, blueprints, manifests, and real-code inspectors.
CI-FULL must protect only the current simple capability-machine mainline and must not preserve retired governance as active quality truth.
active audit inspectors must not reference retired governance vocabulary as positive enforcement targets.
GrassEye uses one simple capability-machine constitution: AI composes registry-backed atomic abilities and the system dispatches owner groups and records evidence.
every ability group owns one public contract and one child-boundary catalog.
Commander, Orchestration, Nerve Bus, and Forensics each have one fixed authority boundary in the capability machine.
owner evidence minimum fields are fixed across every governed execution.
every governed execution must leave evidence, log, and trace.
ability groups must keep hard boundaries and topology must reflect ownership.
Capability Catalog and MuscleMemoryCatalog are generated read models, not new owners.
AI-generated retired-flow drafting must use the governed capability catalog.
non-AI body groups and support layers must not own video-change cognition or revive verify-video-changed-after-scroll.
non-AI active ability groups must not publish AI-owned cognition or revive retired support surfaces.
MuscleMemoryCatalog is the governed capability registry and must not become a workflow, package, or semantic-shortcut library.
every capability group is an owner department that provides one class of executable child capabilities.
every child capability must be the smallest governed executable action and must stay atomic, concrete, and behaviorally unambiguous.
AI selects exactly one registered atomic capability per round while the system validates, injects, dispatches, and records evidence.
semantic actions, package entries, and flow entries may exist only as transitional residue and must not define final registry truth.
support sub-contracts are active parent-domain supplements, not capability groups and not child capabilities.
every child capability exposed to the capability registry or AI composition must prove atomic executable strength.
Code Purity Is Structure Guardrail Only
Small Files Are The Foundation
Small Functions Are Mandatory
Owner Boundary Must Stay Clean
Retired Surface Must Never Return
No Dead Files, Dead Imports, Or Fake Paths
No Escape Hatches
Refactor Means Physical Simplification
Code Purity Inspector Must Stay Small
code-topology is an active capability-group-governance support sub-contract for canonical roots, not an execution owner.
feature and support paths are consumers or boundaries, not owners.
retired feature roots must be physically deleted after migration.
Forensics Persistence must use one clean internal topology and must physically delete old runtime/store roots.
Commander Console is the only owner of human command entry and review-disposition entry.
issue-human-command is start-mission-only and Commander command entry must not absorb round continuity or revive approve/reject command routes.
DOM automation must be a standalone pluggable capability group and must not be coupled to visual missions or business plugins.
DOM snapshot must produce a governed structural summary, not leak full page secrets or raw browser storage.
DOM element location must be semantic-first and selector-stable, not brittle hardcoded CSS-only targeting.
DOM text input must only type approved task-provided text and must not let AI invent business values.
DOM click must target a located DOM element, not arbitrary visual coordinates, unless the DOM path fails and review mode is entered.
File upload must only use approved task-provided files and must verify file type, existence, and upload target.
DOM state verification must produce evidence-backed success, failure, or review-required results.
Business plugins must call DOM abilities but must not add platform-specific branching into the DOM capability group.
DOM automation must stop into review-required mode when login, captcha, ambiguity, or sensitive confirmation is encountered.
Every DOM automation step must produce structured logs and evidence refs without leaking sensitive page data.
every persisted record must preserve short-chain mission truth only.
storage health and record proof must preserve durability truth without retired map fields.
Geometry Guard input must carry short-chain mission truth plus governed coordinate evidence only.
Geometry Guard proof must preserve normalized geometry truth and short-chain refs only.
local-ai remains an internal call boundary only.
current phase keeps one governed local model path with no fallback universe.
local prompt usage must be sourced from the AI prompt contract, not a second registry universe.
local startup readiness stays governed and separate from AI business judgment.
local-app-shell is an active commander-console support sub-contract for local shell form, not an execution owner.
shell layers must stay separated from command and mission truth.
desktop packaging is a wrapper, not a second architecture.
startup is a bounded local bootstrap path.
browser-session is an active Open support sub-contract for real-Chrome reuse, not an execution owner.
local-persistence-schema is an active Forensics support sub-contract for schema truth, not an execution owner.
schema terms must align to ForensicsRecordEnvelope and artifact refs rather than legacy domain objects.
Mouse Click input must carry short-chain mission truth plus approved executable geometry only.
Mouse Click proof must preserve primitive click truth and short-chain mission refs only.
Mouse Scroll input must carry short-chain mission truth plus approved executable geometry only.
Mouse Scroll proof must preserve primitive scroll truth and short-chain mission refs only.
every governed command envelope must carry short-chain mission truth only.
transfer proof must preserve the same short-chain fields as the governed envelope.
Nerve Bus active child surface must be generic envelope transport, not directional channel taxonomy.
Queue, sequence, retry, and fallback infrastructure are not active Nerve Bus truth in the current simple-machine phase.
Open input must carry short-chain mission truth plus governed target identity only.
Open proof must preserve navigation attempt truth and short-chain refs only.
Runtime Log Spine Is Not An Owner
FLOW / DEBUG / TRACE Are Mandatory
RuntimeLogEvent Shape Is Fixed
AI Four-Piece Logs Are Mandatory
Terminal Is Not Truth
Redaction Is Mandatory
Console Scatter Is Forbidden
Runtime Logging Inspector Must Stay Small
Screenshot is a camera + coordinate-grid provider only. Small, focused, no subsystems.
Screenshot proof proves image/artifact/gridSpec truth only.
GrassEye must operate only with user-authorized local accounts while minimizing sensitive capture and never bypassing platform security.
Prompt contracts and AI-generated maps must never request sensitive secrets or hidden bypass channels.
Sensitive tasks require review gates before mutating user data or high-risk platform state.
startup-entrypoint is the only bootstrap source and must never become a second runtime or mission owner.
startup readiness must be shell/bootstrap readiness only and must not revive retired package chain gates.
startup may open Commander Console but must not own mission truth, platform truth, or visual judgment truth.
terminal structured logs are display channel only and must show bootstrap readiness truth without becoming a second record system.
Text Input input must carry short-chain mission truth plus approved text and verified target refs only.
Text Input proof must preserve primitive write truth and short-chain mission refs only.
all external uncertainty must become validated domain types before it can drive actions or records.
video-download is a standalone media artifact capability group, not a DOM helper, product judge, plugin shortcut, or platform workflow.
video download must use only user-authorized local page access and must never bypass credentials, login, CAPTCHA, risk controls, DRM, or platform protections.
Facebook and TikTok downloaders are platform child capabilities that download one target video once and must not become business workflows.
every media candidate must be validated before download success can be claimed.
every download attempt must leave Forensics-compatible artifact proof and structured failure evidence.
downloaded video artifacts may feed AI analysis, but video-download must not own AI product judgment.
